blocks.text: South Korea’s relationship with the North, always strained, seems to be going through a particularly hostile patch in recent weeks. Last month, Seoul accused North Korea of planting a mine on the southern side of the heavily fortified border. The device exploded, injuring three South Korean soldiers. Pyongyang refused to apologize and insisted this was a false-flag incident designed to tarnish the isolated nation.
